title: Wake displays before restoring keyboard and clamshell state
author: RenanBezerraGuima
body:
## What

`omarchy-system-wake` ran three steps sequentially on every wake (idle activity and post-unlock):

1. `omarchy-brightness-display on` — lights the panels (user-visible)
2. `omarchy-brightness-keyboard restore`
3. `omarchy-hyprland-monitor-clamshell` — can take seconds on docked setups when it triggers `hyprctl reload`

Only step 1 is on the critical path. Steps 2 and 3 now run in the background, so the session is responsive as soon as the displays are lit. Ordering is preserved: DPMS enable still runs first.

## Side-effect fix

Both QML callers (`idle/Service.qml` `cancelIdleCycle`, `lock/Service.qml` `runWake`) skip a wake while a previous one is still `running`. A slow clamshell (with reload) used to hold the process open, so a second wake event during that window was dropped entirely — including its DPMS enable. With the script returning fast, every wake lights the display.

## Numbers (this machine: single eDP-1, no kbd backlight)

5 runs each, `omarchy-system-wake` wall time:

| | run1 | run2 | run3 | run4 | run5 | median |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Before (sequential) | 171ms | 153ms | 151ms | 151ms | 151ms | ~151ms |
| After (display foreground, rest background) | 38ms | 30ms | 33ms | 31ms | 31ms | ~31ms |

~5x faster here; on docked multi-monitor setups where clamshell reloads Hyprland config, the win is seconds, not milliseconds.

## Testing

- `bash -n bin/omarchy-system-wake` — clean
- `test/shell.d/monitor-recovery-test.sh` — all 18 checks pass (before and after), including "system wake resyncs clamshell display state"
- `test/cli` — passes (command metadata untouched)
- Manual: `omarchy system lock` → unlock lights the panel immediately; background jobs finish cleanly (`pgrep` shows nothing left behind); `hyprctl monitors -j` reports `dpmsStatus: true`; clamshell toggle state unchanged

## Out of scope (possible follow-up)

The synchronous `sleep 4` + `supergfxctl` transitions in the `force-igpu` system-sleep `post` hook also stall resume for Integrated-mode users, but changing it would break the synchronous expectations in `system-sleep-ownership-migration-test.sh`. Left for a separate PR.

files.patch:
@@ -5,6 +5,10 @@
 # omarchy:name=wake
 # omarchy:examples=omarchy system wake
 
+# Restore display brightness immediately in foreground to light up panels fast
 omarchy-brightness-display on
-omarchy-brightness-keyboard restore
-omarchy-hyprland-monitor-clamshell >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+
+# Keyboard brightness restoration and clamshell monitor detection are secondary
+# and can run asynchronously so they don't delay session responsiveness.
+omarchy-brightness-keyboard restore >/dev/null 2>&1 &
+omarchy-hyprland-monitor-clamshell >/dev/null 2>&1 || true &
